_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from fandom route text + 2 annotated images. Tibia 7.4 vanilla; verify on Rivalia. Route through the Kazordoon mines to the Steam Boat dock (useful for the Postman Quest). The steamship itself is a boat-link, NOT a walkable tile — reaching it ends the on-foot route.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground, higher=deeper). down = descend one floor (ladder/stairs/hole).
_meta.legend: steps[] is an ordered walking sequence. The path descends repeatedly through the mines (each dotted-yellow marker = a ladder/hole transition) then boards the steam ship to Cormaya.

from: Kazordoon Entrance (surface, green dot on map 1)
to: Steam ship to Cormaya (boat dock deep in the mines)

start.note: Kazordoon Entrance marked with green dot; exact coords not given in source

min_level_note: Text: face Bats, Rotworms, Dwarves and Dwarf Soldiers through the mines. A less dangerous but longer alternative avoids Dwarf Soldiers.

alternatives.text: A less dangerous but LONGER way exists with NO Dwarf Soldiers.

You can buy an ore-wagon ticket and ride the wagon directly to the steamship from the depot, temple, main entrance, or shops (or indirectly from the magic carpet and the N/S/W surface entrances) — bypassing the on-foot mine descent entirely.

steps.heading: S
steps.text: From the Kazordoon Entrance (green dot, top-left), head down the long corridor and take 'Down the stairs' (dotted marker, bottom of the red entrance box).

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Follow the white line EAST through the tunnel network out of the entrance chamber toward the first ladder cluster.
At the middle marker use the 'Down and up these ladders' spot — a ladder pair that steps you down then back up to route around an obstacle, continuing EAST.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Continue EAST to the right-hand marker 'Down these ladders' (dotted line) and descend. The map notes '(see next map)' — the route continues on Steamship_kazordoon2.gif.
Continued from last map: at top-left take 'Down this ladder', then follow the white line SW.

steps.heading: S
steps.text: At the bottom-left marker 'Go down here' descend again (dotted line runs EAST to the next box).
Middle box: 'Down here again' — one more descent, then the dotted line continues EAST toward the dock chamber.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Right box: follow the white line up into the water chamber and board the 'Steam ship to Cormaya' (the vessel on the blue water). This boat-link is the route's end — you sail, you do not walk onward.
